limits: Bounded libgimp main-return lifecycle prerequisite; no full DnD clean claim.
All 93 original 08.017 source duties remain TODO; original completion remains 140/661 and all three ledgers remain unchanged.
The earlier orientation checker omitted the LibGimp warning domain. Historical orientation receipts remain preserved; their warning-clean interpretation is explicitly corrected.

Older orientation acceptance also omitted inherited GIMP-Error gradient-save diagnostics in 11 of 12 orientation rows in each mode. Those gradient/XCF fixture issues are a separate prerequisite and are not fixed or accepted by this protocol repair.
Native Linux and address,undefined builds only; leak detection is disabled and third-party libraries are not instrumented.
Successful GP_PROC_RETURN is terminal. Query, init, early exit, genuine failed writes, and temporary returns retain their prior behavior.
The one explicitly named recoverable failed-write control uses fatal-criticals to inspect two existing warnings. Ordinary successful paths keep fatal-warnings.
No Windows, GIR, physical drag transport, full migration acceptance, or unchanged historical DnD acceptance is inferred.
Root alone verifies remote preimages, new-path absence, final authorization, preservation and publication. This package makes no network calls.

real_application_controls.limits: Focused real-application lifecycle controls only; neither a full app suite nor full DnD acceptance. TAP has no skips; benign plug-in discovery/localization notices are enumerated separately.
